Buying · shipping · pickup

Shipping & pickup. Everything leaves from Miami.

In the US, shipping is free on orders over $500 and $25 flat otherwise, and in-stock items ship in 1–3 business days. Or pick your order up free at the Miami showroom. Outside the US, we ship under DAP terms: duties and taxes are paid on arrival.

01 · Shipping in the US

Free over $500. Otherwise $25.

  1. Cost

    One flat rule

    Orders over $500 ship free anywhere in the US. Below that, shipping is $25 flat, whatever the carrier.

  2. Handling

    Ships in 1–3 business days

    In-stock items leave Miami within 1–3 business days by FedEx, UPS or USPS. Orders placed after 4 pm Miami time, or on a weekend, count from the next business day (estimate).

  3. Delivery

    About 1–5 business days

    That’s our estimate of the trip after the order ships. Carriers don’t guarantee delivery dates.

  4. Tracking

    Follow it

    Once the order ships, the tracking comes to your e-mail.

Try it on the checkout: the shipping line updates with your bag, and the delivery estimate appears with your ZIP code.

Good to know

  • Your address: if the carrier can’t match it, checkout suggests a correction and asks you to confirm it.
  • Too big for a parcel? Freight is quoted by our team, and the order waits for that quote before it ships.
  • Puerto Rico, the US Virgin Islands and Guam: shipping by quote.
  • Sales tax is worked out from the delivery address. Tax-exempt purchasing.

02 · When it ships

In stock, backorder, special order.

Each listing says where the item stands. The delivery estimate appears at checkout once your address is in.

In stock

Ships in 1–3 business days

In Miami now. It leaves within 1–3 business days, or waits for you at the showroom. Our team confirms stock before you pay.

Backorder · “Ships in about …”

Its own lead time

Ordered from the supplier for you, so it ships on that item’s lead time: the product page says “Ships in about … business days”. Our team confirms the date before you pay.

Special order

Ordered for you

Brought in on request for your order. Special orders can’t be returned: see the exceptions.

If we can’t ship in the time we stated, we tell you and offer to cancel with a full refund.

03 · Pickup in Miami

Free pickup at the showroom.

Choose “Pick up at our Miami showroom” at checkout. No shipping charge.

  • WhenPick up today when the item is at the showroom. If it isn’t there yet, checkout shows when it will be ready.
  • Ready to collectWe tell you when your order is ready.
  • HoursMonday to Friday, 9 am–5 pm Miami time. Orders paid outside opening hours are ready the next business day at the earliest.
  • Sales taxStill applies on a pickup: Florida’s 6% plus Miami-Dade’s 1% surtax, unless your organization is tax-exempt.
  • Returns30 days from the pickup day, and you can bring a return back here. Returns at the showroom.

04 · Brazil and other countries

Outside the US: DAP.

International shipments go under DAP terms. The price and shipping you pay to i9Store don’t cover import duties, taxes (VAT/IVA), customs brokerage, storage or any other charge in the destination country. The carrier or customs collects them from you on arrival.

Brazil

Direct from Miami

Shipped from Miami to your door. The recipient’s CPF goes on the invoice. We don’t estimate Brazilian import taxes. Prefer a Brazilian invoice with everything included? Buy from the i9Store Brasil marketplace.

Other countries

Rates, or a quote

Carrier rates appear at checkout where a courier serves your address; otherwise ask for a shipping quote. Some countries need the recipient’s tax ID on the customs form.

Restricted items

Some go by quote

Large lithium batteries, and some radio equipment such as wireless microphones, can be quote-only for some countries.

The $25 flat rate and free shipping over $500 are for US addresses. Refused the package, or the charges on arrival? What happens to the refund.

Shipping questions.

Cost, dates, pickup and international orders.

How much is shipping?

In the US, shipping is free on orders over $500 and $25 flat otherwise. Pickup at the Miami showroom is free.

When will my order arrive?

In-stock items ship from Miami in 1–3 business days. Delivery takes about 1–5 business days after that: an estimate, not a carrier guarantee. Orders placed after 4 pm Miami time, or on a weekend, count from the next business day.

Is pickup free? Do I still pay sales tax?

Pickup is free. Sales tax still applies: Florida’s 6% plus Miami-Dade’s 1% surtax, unless your organization is tax-exempt with an approved certificate.

What does Backorder mean?

The item isn’t in Miami right now and is ordered from the supplier, so it ships on its own lead time: the product page says “Ships in about … business days” for that item, and our team confirms the date with you before you pay.

Do you ship to Brazil and other countries?

Yes, from Miami, under DAP terms: import duties, taxes and fees aren’t included and are paid on arrival. Where no carrier rate is available for your address, ask for a shipping quote.

Can I ship an item that’s too big for a parcel?

Yes. Freight is quoted by our team, and the order waits for that quote before it ships.
